blocks.html: The United Kingdom remains one of the most preferred destinations for higher education among Indian students. With globally ranked universities, one-year master’s programs, and strong post-study work opportunities, the UK continues to attract thousands of Indian applicants every year.

However, securing a student visa is one of the most crucial steps in the journey. Even small documentation errors can lead to delays or rejection. This guide explains the UK student visa process for Indian students step by step for 2026, along with expert insights from UEMS Ventures.
Understanding the UK Student Visa Type Students planning to pursue higher education in the UK must apply for the Student Route Visa (previously Tier 4 Visa).
This visa allows students to:

items: Study full-time at a licensed UK university
Work up to 20 hours per week during term time
Apply for the Graduate Route after completing studies

FAQs – UK Student Visa Process for Indian Students
1. How much bank balance is required for UK student visa? Students must show full tuition fees plus 9 months of living expenses as per UK guidelines.
2. How long does UK visa processing take from India? Typically around 3 weeks after biometrics submission.
3. Can UK student visa get rejected after CAS? Yes, if financial or documentation requirements are not properly met.
4. Is IELTS mandatory for UK student visa? It depends on university requirements. Some universities may waive IELTS based on academic background.
